_doc: A dungeon part set (biome). kind: tile (template-guided, exact iso geometry), wall_decor (a wall tile with something mounted on it), prop (free object, cut out and fitted to `footprint` tiles wide). shape: floor | wall | pillar. height in tile units (1 = tile/2 px). ids match content definitions where they exist (tile.*, feature kinds); prop.* are visual decor. Prompts are added after the dungeon style descriptors.
